# Logger.error() method

Logs at ERROR level.

**Signature:**

```typescript
error(...args: any[]): void;
```

## Remarks

Pass an `Error` and it is formatted like the console would — including the stack. Passing `error.stack` explicitly is the usual choice when the record has to stay one line for a log shipper.
